newsitem.title: NORWAY: Gjelsten appointed new Aker CEO.
newsitem.headline: Gjelsten appointed new Aker CEO.

text.p: Aker's board of directors has unanimously appointed Bjoern Rune Gjelsten as new president and chief executive officer of Aker ASA, the Norwegian industrial group said in a statement on Thursday.
Gjelsten, 40, a co-founder of investment group Research Group International (RGI), will take up the position when current president and CEO Tom Ruud steps down on November 1 as planned, it said.
Gjelsten will resign as chairman of Aker's board of directors, a position he has held since April. A new chairman is expected to be appointed and take his place by the end of the year.
The boards of Aker and RGI recently proposed to merge operations.
